In reverse motion, the powder cloud contracts from the edges toward the center. Concurrently, white tile fragments fly inward from the right, top, and bottom of the frame, converging in the center-middle ground. The hammer, initially embedded in the powder in the center-left, lifts upward and moves toward the top left of the frame. The scene concludes with the reassembled tile and powder pile resting in the center on the background concrete surface, as the hammer hovers in the upper left foreground.
